_om: Verktøykassa in English (Toolbox, rusj.no/en/toolbox/) – party tools: who goes first, dice, team picker, rock paper scissors, heads or tails, random number, scorekeeper, timer. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Kron|Kron» and «Mynt|Mynt» are the tallies under the coin (Heads, Tails); «Mynt» alone is the tool (Coin). Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Alle legger en finger på skjermen – mobi: Everyone puts a finger on the screen – the phone picks
Mot mobilen eller hverandre: Against the phone or each other
Velg fra og til – uten å gjenta tall: Pick a range – with no repeats
Alle legger en finger på skjermen: Everyone put a finger on the screen
Keep it still – then the phone picks.
Flere må være med!: More people need to join in!
The order is ready for {n} fingers.
The colour under your finger shows your team.
En finger er valgt. Den som har den lyse: A finger has been chosen. Whoever has the glowing ring goes first!
Små verktøy til spillkvelden. Alt virker: Handy little tools for game night. Everything works offline, and nothing is sent anywhere.
Alle legger en finger på skjermen og hol: Everyone puts a finger on the screen and keeps it still. After a moment the phone picks one – or an order, or two teams.
Terninger, rettferdige lag, «Stein, saks: Dice, fair teams, ‘Rock, paper, scissors’, heads or tails and a random number – one tap away.
Poengtelleren holder styr på opptil åtte: The scorekeeper keeps track of up to eight players. The timer counts down or works as a stopwatch.
«Hvem starter?» virker best når mobilen: ‘Who goes first?’ works best with the phone lying flat on the table.
Navnene du skriver inn, huskes i alle sp: The names you type in are remembered in every game on rusj.no.
Trykket feil i poengtelleren? «Angre» ta: Tapped the wrong button in the scorekeeper? ‘Undo’ takes back the last tap.
Ingen berøringsskjerm? Bruk «Trekk et na: No touchscreen? Use ‘Draw a name instead’.
Legg en finger hver på denne flaten: Everyone put a finger on this area
Lagene blir like store – eller så like s: The teams will be the same size – or as close as possible.
Velg i hemmelighet – den andre ser bort: Choose in secret – the other player looks away 🙈
Stein, saks, papir mot mobilen: Rock, paper, scissors against the phone
Velg – mobilen velger samtidig: Choose – the phone picks at the same time
Alle tallene er trukket!: All the numbers have been drawn!
Som et lotteri: hvert tall trekkes bare: Like a raffle: each number is drawn only once.
Hvor mye hvert trykk gir: How much each tap is worth
Mobilen trekker blant {navn} fra lagdele: The phone draws from {navn} in the team picker.
